summary: The subelements lookup walks a list of dictionaries and iterates a list under a given (possibly nested) key in each.
questions: How do I loop over a nested list inside each user dict?

answer_card.title: subelements lookup
answer_card.answer_md: The `subelements` lookup walks a list of dictionaries and then iterates over a list found at a given (nested) key inside each record. In the loop, `item.0` is the record and `item.1` is the subelement.
